description: This file defines the EventParsingIterator class, which implements an iterator for parsing and handling binary encoded event streams in AWS SDK. It includes logic for selecting appropriate decoding strategies based on stream seekability and parsing individual events, headers, and payloads.

classes.name: EventParsingIterator
classes.description: An iterator that parses a binary encoded AWS event stream, handling event decoding, validation, and event emission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a stream, its shape, and a parser, selecting the appropriate decoding iterator.

methods.name: chooseDecodingIterator
methods.description: Selects the decoding iterator implementation based on whether the stream is seekable.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current event after parsing.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next event.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is valid.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses an individual event, handling error and initial response types, and extracting event data based on its shape.

methods.name: parseEventHeaders
methods.description: Parses the headers of an event based on its shape.

methods.name: parseEventPayload
methods.description: Parses the payload of an event according to its shape, handling binary blob types and deserializing other types via the parser.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Handles error events by throwing an exception with error details.

methods.name: parseInitialResponseEvent
methods.description: Parses an initial response event payload into an associative array.
